viewerNote: You can see these tools, but only members can use them. Ask an org owner for the member role.

checks.title: Readiness check
checks.description: Before a task is used in tests, Heimdall checks it is fair: a correct solution must pass and an agent that does nothing must fail. Step 1, Check files: finds mistakes in the task files. Step 2, Freeze: pins every task so each run sees the same version. Step 3, Run readiness check: tries each task and marks it Ready or Not ready.
checks.admitConfirm: Run the readiness check on every task of {{suite}}? This builds images and tries a correct solution for each task.
checks.hostedAdmit: The readiness check runs a perfect reference agent and a do-nothing agent on each task, on a worker (Workers page). Ready tasks can be run right after.
checks.hostedAdmitConfirm: Run the readiness check on every task of {{suite}}? Each task runs on a worker in practice mode (no real model, free).

health.title: Pause tasks
health.description: A paused task is left out of new tests. Past results do not change. Restore puts it back.
health.flaky: Pause tasks with an unreliable grader
health.flakyConfirm: Pause every task of {{suite}} whose grader gave different answers for the same work?
health.empty: This suite has no tasks yet. Cut one from a commit below.
health.reasonRequired: Type a reason first: say why the task is paused.

source.githubHint: Private repositories need GitHub connected in Settings. Public ones work without it.
source.localHint: A git repository on the server's disk, absolute or relative to the project folder.

fromCommit.title: Task from a commit
fromCommit.description: Make a task from a past bug fix: the agent starts from the code before the fix, and the fix itself becomes the correct solution and hidden checks.
fromCommit.tests: Which test files to hide (optional, comma-separated)
fromCommit.missing: Fill in task id, both commits, and pick a repository.

mine.title: Find tasks in your history
mine.description: Looks through recent bug-fix commits that changed tests and makes ready tasks from the best ones.
mine.hostedDryRun: A full search makes the tasks, runs the readiness check on a worker (Workers page), and keeps only the tasks that pass.
